name: dropdown-menu
title: Dropdown Menu
description: Anchored action menu with header, body, and footer. Rows compose List Item. Prefer Option List for pickers that keep a selected value.

api.description: Anchored action menu for profile menus, workspace switchers, three dot menus, and toolbar actions. Compose Content with Header, Body, and Footer. Items fire onSelect and close by default. Rows compose List Item. Prefer Option List when the panel should keep a selected value without running a command.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state. Placement still uses DropdownMenuTrigger when something else sets open.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is not passed. The menu manages open after that.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when open changes from the trigger, dismiss, item select, or parent updates.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu after an item activates. Set false to keep the menu open.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually DropdownMenuTrigger and DropdownMenuContent.

groups.title: DropdownMenuTrigger
groups.description: Placement anchor and toggle. Click, Enter, and Space toggle. ArrowDown opens. Escape closes when open.

props.name: render
props.description: Host element for the trigger. Toggles open and marks the anchor. Use a Button, icon button, or avatar control.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content when not using render.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the trigger host.

groups.title: DropdownMenuContent
groups.description: Anchored surface shell. Place Header, Body, and Footer as children. Handles arrows, Home, End, typeahead, Escape, and Tab.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the trigger. Combine with align for corners. With collisionAvoidance, the panel can flip when space is tight.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the placement side. auto picks start, center, or end from available space.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the trigger and the menu, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the alignment axis, in pixels.

props.name: width
props.description: Panel width. hug sizes to content. fill matches the trigger when portaled, or the parent when portal is false. Pass a CSS length for a fixed panel.

props.name: itemSize
props.description: Default List Item density for rows in this panel. Use sm for a compact menu. Per-item size overrides this.

props.name: matchTriggerWidth
props.default: true when width is fill, otherwise false
props.description: Match the menu width to the trigger when portaled. Defaults to true when width is fill.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render in a document body portal. Set false for an inline panel. Outside dismiss runs only when portal is true.

props.name: dismissOnScroll
props.description: Close when the page scrolls outside the menu.

props.name: followScroll
props.description: Keep the panel anchored to the trigger while the page scrolls.

props.name: collisionAvoidance
props.description: Flip placement and cap height to the viewport when space is tight. Body scrolls when rows overflow. Set false to keep the requested side and align.

props.name: animated
props.description: Open and close motion from the placement side. Set false for an instant panel. prefers-reduced-motion disables motion.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Open motion duration in milliseconds. Defaults to --df-dropdown-menu-open-duration.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Close motion duration in milliseconds. Defaults to --df-dropdown-menu-close-duration.

props.name: background
props.description: Panel fill. Prefer tokens such as var(--popover). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-bg.

props.name: foreground
props.description: Panel text color. Prefer tokens such as var(--popover-foreground). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-fg.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Border color. Prefer tokens such as var(--border). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-border-color.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Border width. Prefer tokens such as var(--border-width-hairline). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-border-width.

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Border style. Prefer solid. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-border-style.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius. Prefer tokens such as var(--radius-2xl). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-radius.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Panel box-shadow. Off by default. Pass a kit elevation token such as var(--df-shadow-md), or none or false to stay flat. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-shadow.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Header and separator hairline color. Prefer var(--border). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-divider-color.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inset on all sides. Prefer spacing tokens. Overridden by axis and side props.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between header, body, and footer. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-gap.

props.name: children
props.description: Usually DropdownMenuHeader, DropdownMenuBody, and DropdownMenuFooter.

groups.title: DropdownMenuHeader
groups.description: Top section above the body with an edge-to-edge bottom rule. Use for profile blocks or selection status. Title becomes the menu accessible name when present.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading media such as Avatar. Omit or pass false to hide it.

props.name: title
props.description: Primary label. Truncates with an ellipsis when the panel is too narrow.

props.name: description
props.description: Supporting line under the title, usually an email. Truncates when narrow.

props.name: meta
props.description: Below the description in the copy column. Prefer Badge for plan or status.

props.name: trailing
props.description: End-aligned mark on the header row. Prefer Badge for a count or status chip.

props.name: background
props.description: Header fill. Prefer tokens. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-header-bg.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between leading, copy, and trailing. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-header-gap.

props.name: titleColor
props.description: Title color. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-title-color.

props.name: titleSize
props.description: Title font size. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-title-size.

props.name: titleWeight
props.description: Title font weight. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-title-weight.

props.name: descriptionColor
props.description: Description color. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-description-color.

props.name: descriptionSize
props.description: Description font size. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-description-size.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Header bottom rule color. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-divider-color for this header.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inset on all sides. Prefer spacing tokens. Overridden by axis and side props.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: children
props.description: Extra header content below the title row.

groups.title: DropdownMenuBody
groups.description: Middle section with role menu. Place action rows, labels, and separators here. Uses the kit ScrollArea; the thumb appears when rows overflow.

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between rows. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-body-gap.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Apply maxHeight for an intentional height cap. Collision avoidance already scrolls when the viewport is tight.

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Height constraint when scrollable is true. Prefer tokens.

props.name: scrollThumbGap
props.description: Space on each side of the scrollbar thumb, in pixels. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-scroll-thumb-gap.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inset on all sides. Prefer spacing tokens. Overridden by axis and side props.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: children
props.description: DropdownMenuItem rows, plus optional labels and separators.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the body.

groups.title: DropdownMenuItem
groups.description: Action row composed with List Item. Place inside DropdownMenuBody. Activates onSelect, then closes when closeOnSelect is true.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when the item activates. Call event.preventDefault() to keep the menu open even when closeOnSelect is true.

props.name: tone
props.description: Visual tone. Use destructive for remove actions.

props.name: variant
props.description: List Item color recipe. muted uses muted-foreground for quieter rows.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading icon or status mark. Passed to List Item.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Unicode keyboard hint in the trailing slot via kit Kbd, such as ⌘K. Display only; host owns key bindings.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing content. Submenu triggers add a chevron when omitted.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Secondary text under the label.

props.name: layout
props.description: List Item copy layout.

props.name: selected
props.description: Shows the end check when indicator is not overridden. Use for preference rows and the active workspace.

props.name: indicator
props.description: Force the end check on or off. Defaults to true when selected is true.

props.name: leadingFit
props.description: Leading track sizing. Use content for Avatar and other non-icon marks.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element as the row host, usually a link.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable activation and skip keyboard focus.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Presentational row. Not activatable and skipped for keyboard focus.

props.name: size
props.description: List Item density for this row. Defaults to Content itemSize when set, otherwise md.

props.name: children
props.description: Item label.

groups.title: DropdownMenuShortcut
groups.description: Keyboard hint for menu rows. Renders kit Kbd at size sm. Prefer the shortcut prop on DropdownMenuItem.

props.name: children
props.description: Unicode shortcut label such as ⌘K. Textual forms such as Ctrl+K are not parsed.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the shortcut host.

groups.title: DropdownMenuSeparator
groups.description: Hairline rule between item groups inside the body.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Hairline color for this rule. Prefer tokens such as var(--border). Sets --df-dropdown-menu-divider-color.

props.name: marginBlock
props.description: Vertical space around the rule. Prefer spacing tokens. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-separator-margin-block.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional styles on the separator.

groups.title: DropdownMenuLabel
groups.description: Non-interactive group label above a set of items in the body.

props.name: color
props.description: Label color. Prefer tokens. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-label-color.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Label type size. Prefer tokens. Sets --df-dropdown-menu-label-size.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inset on all sides. Prefer spacing tokens. Overridden by axis and side props.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: children
props.description: Label copy.

groups.title: DropdownMenuSubmenu
groups.description: Hover-open nested action branch. Place a DropdownMenuItem trigger and DropdownMenuSubContent as children. Motion defaults come from CSS tokens and can be overridden here or on SubContent.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled submenu open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state when open is not passed.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the submenu open state changes.

props.name: animated
props.description: Open and close motion for this branch. Set false for an instant panel.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Open motion duration in milliseconds. Defaults to --df-dropdown-menu-submenu-open-duration.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Close motion duration in milliseconds. Defaults to --df-dropdown-menu-submenu-close-duration.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Hover leave delay before the submenu closes, in milliseconds.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger item and DropdownMenuSubContent.

groups.title: DropdownMenuSubContent
groups.description: Nested menu surface. Defaults to the right of the trigger row and portals to the document body. Shares Content surface chrome. Placement and motion can be set per panel.

props.name: side
props.description: Preferred side of the trigger row.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the trigger row and the nested panel, in pixels.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment along the placement side.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the alignment axis, in pixels.

props.name: portal
props.description: Render in a document body portal.

props.name: animated
props.description: Per-panel motion override. Set false for an instant panel on this surface.

props.name: openDuration
props.description: Per-panel open duration in milliseconds. Defaults to the submenu token when unset.

props.name: closeDuration
props.description: Per-panel close duration in milliseconds. Defaults to the submenu token when unset.

props.name: shadow
props.description: Nested panel box-shadow. Same contract as DropdownMenuContent shadow.

props.name: background
props.description: Surface fill. Prefer tokens.

props.name: foreground
props.description: Surface text color. Prefer tokens.

props.name: borderColor
props.description: Surface border color. Prefer tokens.

props.name: borderWidth
props.description: Surface border width. Prefer border-width tokens.

props.name: borderStyle
props.description: Surface border style.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius. Prefer radius tokens.

props.name: dividerColor
props.description: Internal divider color. Prefer tokens.

props.name: children
props.description: Nested DropdownMenuItem rows and separators.

groups.title: DropdownMenuFooter
groups.description: Muted meta row under the body, such as version or legal copy. Composed with List Item. Defaults to readOnly. Use asChild for a link host.

props.name: leading
props.description: Optional leading mark. Defaults to no leading slot.

props.name: size
props.description: List Item density.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Presentational meta. Defaults to false when asChild is true so a link stays interactive.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the child element as the row host, usually a link.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inset on all sides. Prefer spacing tokens. Overridden by axis and side props.

props.name: paddingX
props.description: Horizontal inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingY
props.description: Vertical inset. Prefer spacing tokens.

props.name: paddingTop
props.description: Top inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingRight
props.description: Right inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: paddingBottom
props.description: Bottom inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingY and padding.

props.name: paddingLeft
props.description: Left inset. Prefer spacing tokens. Wins over paddingX and padding.

props.name: background
props.description: Row fill. Prefer tokens. See List Item chrome.

props.name: foreground
props.description: Row text color. Prefer tokens. See List Item chrome.

props.name: fontSize
props.description: Row type size. Prefer type tokens. See List Item chrome.

props.name: radius
props.description: Row corner radius. Prefer radius tokens. See List Item chrome.

props.name: children
props.description: Footer copy or link label.

groups.title: Tokens
groups.description: Theme defaults live on :root. Override these globally or on a local host.

props.name: --df-dropdown-menu-shadow
props.description: Panel elevation. Off by default. Set by Content or SubContent shadow.

props.name: --df-dropdown-menu-body-max-height
props.description: Default Body maxHeight when scrollable is true.

props.name: --df-dropdown-menu-label-size
props.description: Default DropdownMenuLabel type size.

props.name: --df-dropdown-menu-header-avatar-size
props.description: Avatar size in Header when title and description are both present.

props.name: --df-dropdown-menu-submenu-open-duration
props.description: Default submenu open motion. Matches Option List nested open timing. Override with Submenu or SubContent openDuration.

props.name: --df-dropdown-menu-submenu-close-duration
props.description: Default submenu close motion. Matches Option List nested close timing. Override with Submenu or SubContent closeDuration.
